get.description: Gives the ability to browse, filter and search histories.

parameters.name: Accept-Language

schema.description: Sets language code. Supported languages are english (en) and polish (pl)

parameters.description: Sets language code. Supported languages are english (en) and polish (pl)

parameters.name: per_page

schema.description: Page size. Default value is 25, max allowed page size is 100.

parameters.description: Page size. Default value is 25, max allowed page size is 100.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Filter instances by ID.

This field provides following filters:

FilterDescriptionExamples
termfilters instances in which ID matches to the provided value.
Note, that this is default filter for this field.		/histories/?id=1
/histories/?id[term]=2
termsfilters instances in which ID matches to any of the provided values./histories/?id[terms]=1,3
/histories/?id[terms]=1&id[terms]=3
gtfilters instances in which ID is is greater than the provided value./histories/?id[gt]=1
gtefilters instances in which ID is greater than or equal to the provided value./histories/?id[gte]=2
ltfilters instances in which ID is lower than the provided value./histories/?id[lt]=3
ltefilters instances that have ID that is lower than or equal to the provided value./histories/?id[lte]=4

parameters.name: action
parameters.description:
Wyszkuj instancje według action.

This field provides the following queries:

QueryDescriptionExamples
matchsearches for instances in which action matches the provided value.
Note, that this is default filter for this field.		/histories/?action=lorem
/histories/?action[match]=lorem
phrasesearches for instances in which action matches the provided phrase./histories/?action[phrase]=lorem ipsum
prefixsearches for instances in which action starts with the provided phrase./histories/?action[prefix]=lorem ips
querysearches for instances that matches the provided query string./histories/?action[query]=*rem* AND ipsum
/histories/?action[query]=lorem OR ipsum
